exercise: Junior AI Engineer take-home, alternative A: AI Order Intake & Exception Handling

development_tools_and_models.notes: Claude Code 2.1.292 CLI on WSL2 with Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5), effort high, permission mode auto; stage-9 subagents on the same model or Sonnet 5.5 for mid-tier review lenses. OpenAI Codex CLI as an independent read-only reviewer inside ce-doc-review. Python 3.12, uv 0.11.2, pytest + Hypothesis, ruff, GitHub Actions.

plugins_and_extensions.notes: compound-engineering 3.22.4 (MIT) drove stage 9: ce-plan, ce-doc-review, ce-work, ce-simplify-code, ce-code-review, ce-compound. Other plugins enabled at user level were not used and are not copied.

application_models_and_parameters.notes: Pipeline: openai/gpt-6-luna via OpenRouter (OpenAI direct fallback), reasoning effort low, seed 7, max 4000 output tokens, tool_choice required via ToolOutput, max 6 requests, one repair. Judge: deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash via OpenRouter (JUDGE_MODEL_ID), temperature 0.2, seed 7+sample, 3 samples per case, max 2000 output tokens. Frameworks: pydantic-ai-slim[openai]==2.54.0, pydantic-evals==2.54.0.

skills.notes: Starter data-generation skill followed as guidance (stage 1). User skill fastapi used to review the web layer (stage 8). compound-engineering skills used for stage 9 planning, plan review, execution, simplification, code review and captured learnings. No custom skills were created.

agent_instructions_and_subagents.notes: Project CLAUDE.md (updated for the stage-9 layout), relevant sections of the user-level CLAUDE.md, one agent memory note. Stage 9 used generic subagents seeded with compound-engineering prompt assets (research, reviewer personas, implementation workers); no custom agent definitions.

hooks_and_scripts.notes: Two user-level PreToolUse hooks were active: attribution stripping, and an rtk command rewriter (third-party token-saving CLI). The project scripts are run manually, not as hooks.

prompts_and_rules.notes: Extraction prompt v1 (stage 3) and v2 (stage 7, clarification wording); judge rubric v1 (stage 9).

tool_and_mcp_settings.notes: Application tools: search_catalog (sequential, strict) and the submit_order_draft ToolOutput; judge output tool submit_verdict. Development: Claude Code built-in tools; the context7 MCP server for PydanticAI documentation (stage 9); other MCP connectors in the session were not used.

permissions_and_environment_names.notes: Read-deny rules for .env files kept the assistant from reading the API key. Variable names are listed; values are never stored.
